verdicts.reason: A: the quote is squeezed into a narrow 5-line column that starts almost at the top edge. The quote mark is moved to mid-height beside the text instead of leading it, and the logo floats centred under the attribution, off the text's left edge. B: it keeps the original's left-column order (quote mark, quote, attribution) with a readable 3-line quote, but the attribution breaks onto two lines and the logo sits beside it as a competing element. The glass also rides high in its circle, leaving an empty lower half.
